definition: Governance = 'forms of organization designed ex ante'; governing = 'spontaneous micro-processes... ex post' (p. 432).
elements: three explanation-types (rent-seeking / misaligned governance / diverse cultures, Table 3)
stakeholders: Politicians, contractors, sponsors, participants. Resolution differs per explanation-type.
decision_making: Yes - typology on cognition x view of the future.
temporality_detail: Ex-ante/ex-post is temporal (p. 436); promoters 'often not in office when the actual viability of a project can be assessed... political capital in the short-term.'
misalignment_detail: Electoral-accountability gap named (promoter out of office), framed as rent-seeking rather than recurring misfit.
gaps: Governing-vs-governance is the dynamic lens; electoral timing named but not modelled.
key_quotes: Governance = 'forms of organization designed ex ante'; governing = 'spontaneous micro-processes... ex post' (p. 432).
Promoters 'often not in office when the actual viability of a project can be assessed... political capital in the short-term' (p. 436).
coding_notes: Esposito & Terlizzi (2023) build directly on this governance/governing distinction - cross-reference.
